the change of HR practices in the SOEs in post-1997 Asia Crisis is driven by the dynamic relationships with the internal and external stakeholders.

SOEs have to change their HR practices in order to survive in the market competition and that the change is determined by their relationships with both internal and external stakeholders, especially the government.
the HRM practices in the SOEs in Indonesia have been transformed to a greater extent since the 1997-1998 Asian Crisis.

the dynamic relationships between institutions and firms and how the firms' responses affect the HR practices.
the dynamic relationships between SOEs and their stakeholders, which is the key to understanding the change in HRM.
the dynamic relationships of firms and their stakeholders, which have implications for both theoretical and practical issues.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Asian Crisis has brought about the transformation of HRM in the Indonesian SOEs.
the Asian Crisis has been a turning point of the Indonesian SOEs in the transformation of HRM practices.
the transformation of HRM in Indonesian SOEs is determined by their relationships with both their stakeholders and the institutional change.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the SOE transformation is a result of the interplay among the institutional, firm, and stakeholder dynamics.
the transformation of Indonesian SOEs is a dynamic process, in which the firms' relationships and the institutional changes are intertwined.

the transformation of the SOEs has been a dynamic process, and the change of HR practices is a part of this process, in which the firms' responses are determined by the relationships with the external and internal stakeholders.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the transformation of HRM is not only driven by internal forces, but also by external forces such as government policy, institutional environment, and market competition.

the HRM changes are not merely the result of the external pressure but also the result of the firm's own strategic choices.
